hardRequirement: The released THC Living Plant Atlas specimen set must read as real photographed cannabis plants across six required states: seedling, vegetative, flowering, male, female, and hermaphrodite/intersex. No stylized, low-poly, plastic, generic, or visibly AI-deformed substitute may satisfy a slot.

criteria.label: Overall photographic realism
criteria.requirement: At normal desktop viewing distance the specimen must plausibly read as a high-end photographed or scanned living cannabis plant appropriate to its declared stage or reproductive phenotype.

criteria.label: Leaflet geometry and serration
criteria.requirement: Leaves must show developmentally appropriate cannabis leaflet proportions, taper, serration, curvature, petiole attachment, and non-repetitive natural variation.

criteria.label: Leaf surface and venation
criteria.requirement: Leaf surfaces, primary/secondary venation, thickness, translucency response, roughness, and color variation must avoid flat card, wax, rubber, or plastic appearance.

criteria.label: Nodes, internodes, and branching
criteria.requirement: Node spacing, branch origins, phyllotaxy cues, internode transitions, branch taper, and junctions must be plausible for the declared developmental state and free of fused or floating geometry.

criteria.label: Stem texture and taper
criteria.requirement: Main stem and branches must show stage-appropriate taper, surface texture, color variation, and structure without smooth toy-like cylinders.

criteria.label: Stage and reproductive accuracy
criteria.requirement: The specimen must visibly support its declared state: seedling, vegetative, flowering, male, female, or hermaphrodite/intersex, without borrowing contradictory reproductive morphology from another slot.

criteria.label: Flower, sugar-leaf, and resin accuracy
criteria.requirement: Where flowers are expected, inflorescences, bracts, stigmas/anthers, sugar leaves, and resin/trichome character must be believable; where mature flowers are not expected, they must not be fabricated into the specimen.

criteria.label: Exposed root architecture
criteria.requirement: The exposed root system must have stage-appropriate crown, structural roots, branching laterals, taper, fine-root transition, and integration with the stem base; no spaghetti bundles or decorative tendrils.

criteria.label: Material and PBR response
criteria.requirement: Materials must respond naturally to lighting with credible roughness, normal detail, translucency/alpha handling where needed, and no glossy plastic or metallic plant tissue.

criteria.label: Color and texture realism
criteria.requirement: Texture color, mottling, gradients, stems, roots, and microvariation must look natural under neutral lighting with no baked yellow cast or obvious procedural tiling.

criteria.label: No obvious AI or generation deformation
criteria.requirement: Reject fused leaves, impossible leaflet counts, duplicated motifs, melted reproductive structures, branch discontinuities, impossible intersections, or any ambiguous deformation being presented as plant biology.

criteria.label: No low-poly or cardboard read
criteria.requirement: Silhouette and close views must not expose coarse faceting, billboard-only foliage, visibly flat reproductive cards, chunky decimation, or game-prop simplification inconsistent with the Atlas target.

criteria.label: Full-plant multi-angle consistency
criteria.requirement: Front, rear, left, right, and top views must remain anatomically coherent with no hidden backside collapse or view-dependent geometry failure.

criteria.label: Mobile LOD fidelity
criteria.requirement: The mobile LOD may reduce hidden complexity and texture resolution but must preserve the specimen's realistic cannabis silhouette, stage/sex identity, branch continuity, leaf serration read, and root-system identity.

female: female floral architecture distinct from male
hermaphrodite: recognizable male and female expression on one specimen
no AI deformation used as a substitute for intersex morphology

notes: A dedicated photorealistic seedling specimen is required.
A dedicated photorealistic vegetative specimen is required.
A mature flowering specimen is required and must show realistic inflorescence and resin character.
A dedicated male specimen must clearly show authentic staminate reproductive morphology.
A dedicated female specimen must clearly show authentic pistillate reproductive morphology.
Hermaphrodite/intersex biology must be represented with identifiable mixed reproductive structures, not visual ambiguity or AI defects.
